description: Is this Uniswap v4 pool the token's official pool, and is it allowed? Chain-wide URC-5 (Token Venue Policy) view of launchpad v2 tokens on Robinhood Chain: counts of tokens by mode (enforced or preferred), pools, canonical and off-list pools, and off-list pools the token's policy does not allow, including how many of those hold liquidity. The list shows only off-list pools that are not allowed by default. Set scope=all for every pool, and page with before (the next_before cursor) and limit. Pass pool_id to look up one pool: pool_lookup answers per token, plus one overall answer that is the most restrictive of them. A pool can hold two launchpad tokens and is judged by each token's own policy. Before graduation a token lists no official pool, so v4 pools holding an ungraduated enforced token are off-list and not allowed. A row whose reads are too old is flagged stale, has no classification, and is counted as withheld. If even the newest read is too old the route answers 503 withheld. For one token's full record use 1s_std_launchpad_token. Values are the last snapshot reads, not live reads.

before.description: Pagination cursor: the next_before value from a prior page

pool_id.description: A Uniswap v4 pool id to look up (0x + 64 hex chars)

scope.description: not_allowed (default) lists off-list pools the token's policy does not allow; all lists every pool

name: 1s_std_launchpad_venues
